The '''battle''' for the [[Darth Vengean's flagship|flagship]] of the [[Dark Council]]lor [[Darth Vengean]] happened in [[3642 BBY]] prompting the initial stages of the [[Galactic War]], between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The battle was arranged by [[Darth Baras]] to ruin his [[Sith Master/Legends|master]] Darth Vengean and was ended when the Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral Monk]] was killed by Darth Baras' [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]].

==Prelude==
In [[3642 BBY]], [[Darth Vengean]] and [[Darth Baras]] enacted [[Plan Zero]] to restart the war between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. As Darth Baras ordered his [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] to [[Destruction of the War Trust|eliminate]] the Republic's [[War Trust]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], Darth Vengean would conquer the fringe [[Star system/Legends|systems]], close to Imperial territory.<ref name="Ambush" />

==The battle==
[[File:MonkBattle.png|thumb|left|190px|Admiral Monk's last stand]]
[[Darth Vengean's flagship]], under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Masken]], was sent to the fringe systems but was intercepted by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Monk (Human)|Monk's]] naval forces and the flagship was besieged. After taking out the War Trust, Darth Baras' apprentice was sent to lift the siege over [[Darth Vengean]]'s [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] and eliminate the Republic admiral. The apprentice was able to lift the siege but Admiral Monk escaped to the surface of the nearby [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]]. The apprentice followed Monk and eliminated him inside [[Fort Phalanx]], discovering him to be part of Darth Baras [[Darth Baras' spy network|spy network]].<ref name="Ambush" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle appeared in the [[2011]] videogame ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as part of Chapter II of the [[Sith Warrior]] class story.<ref name="Ambush" />
